description:
FILED s446i (Opus agent I), from the #509 probes.

REPRODUCERS (perl 5.40.3 on the left, PCL on the right):

    our %hh; $hh{a} = {b=>1};
    { local $hh{a}{b} = 6; print $hh{a}{b}; }
    print ",", $hh{a}{b}, "\n";
        perl  6,1
        PCL   CRASH: "Value of pcl::h in (sb-impl::gethash3 k h nil) is 6,
              not a hash-table" -- the emission is
              (p-local-hash-elem-init %hh "a" 6 â¦), i.e. it localized
              $hh{a} and ASSIGNED 6 TO IT, then $hh{a}{b} read through 6.

    our %h; our $p; $h{a}={b=>1};
    local ($p, $h{a}{b}) = (5,6);
        perl  5,6
        PCL   loud DROP: "Parser2 TODO: unsupported `local` target: $h{"a"}{"b"}"
              (s446i's rule-12 classifier; before s446i it was the same silent
              flattening as the single spelling)

CAUSE: Pl::Parser::_process_local_declaration's single-target branch matches
`@non_ws >= 2 && [0] Symbol && [1] Subscript` and takes $non_ws[1] as THE
subscript, ignoring any further ones; the `=` search then starts after it and
finds the initializer, so the chain's HEAD is localized and assigned the tail's
value.  s446i's _local_target_item (the LIST scan) refuses the shape instead of
flattening it, which is why the two spellings now fail differently.

SHAPE OF A FIX: a chained target is a PLACE like any other -- the container is
the chain minus its last subscript (`(p-gethash %hh "a")` dereferenced), the
key is the last subscript.  The element macros take a container FORM already
(the arrow branch passes `(unbox $ref_cl)`), so the work is building that form
from the chain, in ONE helper both the single branch and _local_target_item
call (they must not drift -- that IS this bug's family).

BAR: the two reproducers above plus `local $h{a}[0]`, `local $a[0]{k}`,
`local $r->{a}{b}`, the restore after the block, and the same six shapes inside
a `local` LIST; a Pl/t guard row in stmt-modifier-01.t or local-elem-02.t;
corpus-diff (no corpus site today -- grep found none in perl-tests, lib,
cpan-tests or perl's own t/).

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 7ea827a6) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- still wrong; the single spelling no longer CRASHES, it is now silent.
    our %hh; $hh{a} = {b=>1};
    { local $hh{a}{b} = 6; print $hh{a}{b}; } print ",", $hh{a}{b}, "\n";
    perl: 6,1      PCL: ,1     (exit 0, nothing on stderr; the restore is right)
  The BAR shapes, same result (perl 7 / 8 / 9 / 6 inside, 1 after; PCL empty inside, 1 after):
    `local $h{a}[0] = 7`, `local $a[0]{k} = 8`, `local $r->{a}{b} = 9`, `local $h{x}{b} = 6`.
  In a LIST, loud as filed: `local ($p, $h{a}{b}) = (5,6);` -> "PCL: statement dropped ... Parser2 TODO: unsupported `local`
  target: $h{"a"}{"b"}", then a die at the drop site (exit 255).  (#509's probe of the same list shape lands here.)
LABEL: silent (subject updated: the crash is gone, the single form is silent; one family with #1190).

=== s543c re-run (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611 -- MAIN-READY-100, after s543b's merge: local TERM,TAIL / undef $fh flush / eval my $x = $x / constants / defined NAME / tr / dirhandles) ===
The reproducers of the s543c block above were re-run on 64353611: output byte-identical to the 7ea827a6 run, so that verdict holds
for 64353611 too.


=== DONE (s543g) ===
Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22.  Pl::Stmt::local_expr_elem_base reads a target that ENDS in a subscript and is not one of the three one-level bases: the element is the LAST subscript, the container the run before it (a `->` dropped), lowered ONCE as an ordinary expression by Parser2::_local_expr_container (an element container takes the plain read's p-viv-container / -array- mark, so it VIVIFIES; any other container is a reference value through the cast form) and bound to a temporary after the right side, before the localization.  ONE reading for the single statement (_local_plan_elem), the `local (...)` list (_local_target_item, which dropped the shape) and `delete local` (_local_plan_delete).  The one-level spellings emit byte for byte as before.  Probes scratch/s543g/probes (the s543g worktree)/m1 (28 files: base 2 = perl, tree 27; the 28th is the registered RT #130727 corner, unchanged), m1b (10, tree all), m1c (string eval: right).  Guards Pl/t/local-elem-02.t M1 M3 (fail on 8959afae); Pl/t/stmt-modifier-01.t's rule-12 drop row moved to a shape that still drops (#5251) + a run row for `local ($p, $h{a}{b}) = (5,6)`.  ir-spec 7.2 "A `local` element target is its LAST subscript".
